title.zh: v2.1.13 离线导出的天花板补上了；顺便发现「同一个页面渲染久了会变声」，并据此重录响度基线、重拟合全部 trim
title.en: v2.1.13 The Offline Export Ceiling Is Real Now — Plus a Measured Discovery: a Long-Lived Page Renders Differently, Which Invalidated the Loudness Baseline

highlights.zh: **导出文件终于一定满足 −1 dBTP。** 离线渲染只有在平台接受 `audioWorklet.addModule` 时才装得上真峰限幅器，装不上就走 DynamicsCompressor 回退——而回退路径**没有天花板**（它自己的告警就这么写）。于是「导出的天花板」变成了「平台支持程度的性质」：把回退路径变成确定事件后 A/B，**6/6 个热曲风超过 −1 dBTP**，arranged 最差 +2.22 dBTP、trim 之后最差 **+0.95 dBTP（tropical-house）**——正是上一版记录到、但当时无法复现的那个数字；补上守卫后 **0/6**，全部 −1.30 dBTP。守卫用的是**限幅器自己的内核**（同一个 `limitBuffers`、同一个 −1.3 dBTP 内部天花板），所以两条路径承诺同一个文件。
highlights.en: **Exports now always hold -1 dBTP.** The offline renderer could only install the true-peak limiter when the platform accepted `audioWorklet.addModule`; otherwise the graph ran the DynamicsCompressor fallback, which has **no ceiling at all** (its own warning says so). The export ceiling was therefore a property of platform support, not of the renderer: forcing the fallback makes the A/B deterministic, and it measured **6/6 hot genres above -1 dBTP**, arranged worst +2.22 dBTP…

highlights.zh: **发现并量到一条更根本的问题：同一个页面渲染约 50–75 次之后，同一个曲风会渲染成另一个东西。** `alternative-rock` 在新页面里连测三次都是 −12.711 LUFS；在同一个页面渲染过 118 个别的曲风之后再连测三次都是 **−10.259**（reload 之后又变回 −12.711）。起跳点实测在 45–75 次之间，峰值仍然钉在 −1.30 dBTP，图案没有被改写，`limiter.dispose()` + `ctx.close()` 挡不住，只有换页面能清除。这意味着**两小时的量测会在中途悄悄换掉「它测的是什么」**：第一次重录的 12 个抽样里有 5 个偏 0.5–2.5 dB。量测装置现在每 12 次测量换一次页面、换完丢弃一次冷渲染，并在每次换页后重测哨兵曲风，漂移超过 0.3 dB 就中止且不写任何文件。
highlights.en: **A more fundamental problem, found and measured: after ~50-75 renders in one page, the same genre renders as something else.** `alternative-rock` measures -12.711 LUFS three times over in a fresh page and **-10.259** three times over after 118 other genres have rendered in that page (a reload restores -12.711). The onset is between 45 and 75 renders, the true peak stays pinned at -1.30 dBTP, the pattern is unmutated, `limiter.dispose()` plus `ctx.close()` does not help, and…

highlights.zh: **响度基线重录 + 全部 trim 重拟合：旧基线本身就是「长页面」量出来的。** 把新基线（新页面、可复现）与已提交基线对比：`ambient` −13.77 → **−18.11**、`kawaii-future-bass` −11.77 → **−15.55**、`chillwave` −17.04 → **−19.65**、`alternative-rock` −10.42 → **−12.71**。污染值偏响 → 拟合出的 trim 偏狠 → 实际播出比类别目标低最多 3.8 dB（这正是 G.51 当年记下的「基线过时」症状，方向刚好对上）。最极端的 `ghetto-house`：它的目标就是它自己能达到的电平，trim 本该是 0，已提交的却是 **−7.84 dB**。新基线 159/159 行、0 个 clamp、真峰最差 −1.275 dBTP、77 条 trim 非零（旧 96 条），71 个曲风变响、19 个变安静。
highlights.en: **The loudness baseline was re-recorded and every trim refitted: the old baseline had itself been recorded on a long-lived page.** Fresh page versus committed table: `ambient` -13.77 to **-18.11**, `kawaii-future-bass` -11.77 to **-15.55**, `chillwave` -17.04 to **-19.65**, `alternative-rock` -10.42 to **-12.71**. Contaminated values ran loud, so the fitted trims cut too hard, which is why those genres sat up to 3.8 dB below their category target -- exactly the symptom G.51…
